title: 第1773章 龙气潮汐真龙宝珠第1772章 贪婪作死
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
白玉水池边缘，暗金色的远古龙血犹如沸腾的岩浆，不断向上翻滚出巨大的气泡，散发着惊人的高温与磅礴的气血威压。
苏铭站在池边，深邃的眸子里闪过一抹火热。
这满满一池子龙血，历经无数岁月依旧未曾干涸，其中蕴含的能量简直难以估量。
若是将其全部吸收入体，玄金霸体绝对能迎来一次质的飞跃。
“退后些，我要布阵将这些龙血封存收取。”
苏铭偏过头，对着身后的聂清秋吩咐了一句。
这等狂暴的神物，稍有不慎溢出一丝气机，都能将寻常曜源境修士焚成灰烬。
聂清秋乖巧地点了点头，向后退了两步。
只是，身处这传说中的龙族大殿，即便是这位见多识广的城主千金，也难免生出几分好奇。
她见苏铭正在专心勾勒阵法符文，便忍不住垫起脚尖，伸长了雪白的脖颈，想要更清楚地看看这远古龙血究竟是何等模样。
然而，就在她身子微微前倾的瞬间。
脚下踩着的一块青玄血纹石地砖，突然发出一声几不可闻的咔嚓声。
这块地砖，正巧是当年龙族大能留下的一处隐秘阵法节点！
轰！
平静的白玉水池在这一刻宛如被引爆的火药桶。
满池暗金色的液体疯狂旋转，一股肉眼可见的粉红色雾气，夹杂着震天动地的龙吟声，化作一阵狂暴的龙气潮汐，直接将站在池边的两人尽数吞没。
“该死！你这女人乱踩什么！”
苏铭面色骤变，忍不住暗骂出声。
这股粉红色雾气刚一入体，他便察觉到了不对劲。
龙性本隐！

这远古龙血中残留的不仅是气血之力，更蕴含着上古真龙最原始、最狂暴的繁衍欲望。
这股潮汐，简直就是世间最霸道的烈性春药！
苏铭冷哼一声，立刻运转阴阳神诀，玄金霸体轰然催动，强行将经脉中乱窜的燥热感压制下去。
凭借着两世为人的坚韧心境，他倒还能保持清明。
但身后的聂清秋，可就没有这般能耐了。
“公子……我好热……”
一道甜腻到令人骨头酥软的娇吟声，在粉红色的雾气中响起。
苏铭转过头，眼前的景象让他的呼吸不由得微微一滞。
原本清冷如冰山雪莲般的城主千金，此刻双颊犹如染血般酡红，一双秋水般的眸子里水光潋滟，哪里还有半点理智可言。
她大口大口地喘着粗气，丰满的胸脯剧烈起伏，仿佛体内有一团无法熄灭的烈火在疯狂燃烧。
在龙气的侵蚀下，聂清秋心底最深处的欲望被无限放大。
她看着前方挺拔冷峻的苏铭，眼神中再无平日里的矜持与高傲，取而代之的是最原始的渴求。
“帮帮我……”
聂清秋媚眼如丝，扭动着火辣妖娆的水蛇腰，步履有些踉跄地朝着苏铭走来。
一边走，她的一双玉手竟是主动攀上了腰间的系带。
轻轻一扯。
名贵的紫色贴身罗裙顺着白皙的肩膀滑落，犹如一朵盛开在迷雾中的妖艳紫罗兰，堆叠在她的脚踝处。
content_en:
At the edge of the white jade pool, the dark golden ancient dragon's blood was like boiling magma, constantly rolling upwards to produce huge bubbles, exuding astonishing high temperatures and majestic blood pressure.
Su Ming stood by the pool, with a flash of fire in his deep eyes.
This full pool of dragon blood has not dried up after countless years, and the energy contained in it is simply immeasurable.
If all of it is absorbed into the body, the Xuanjin Hegemon Body will definitely usher in a qualitative leap.
"Stand back, I'm going to set up a formation to seal and collect the dragon's blood."
Su Ming turned his head and gave instructions to Nie Qingqiu behind him.
Such violent divine objects can burn ordinary Yaoyuan realm monks to ashes if they accidentally leak out a trace of energy.
Nie Qingqiu nodded obediently and took two steps back.
However, being in this legendary Dragon Clan Hall, even the well-informed daughter of the city lord could not help but feel a little curious.
Seeing that Su Ming was concentrating on outlining the formation runes, she couldn't help but stand up on her toes and stretch her snow-white neck, wanting to have a clearer look at what this ancient dragon's blood looked like.
However, the moment she leaned forward slightly.
A Qingxuan blood-patterned stone floor tile under his feet suddenly made an almost inaudible clicking sound.
This floor tile happens to be a secret formation node left by the powerful dragon clan back then!
boom!
The calm white jade pool was like a powder keg being detonated at this moment.
The pool full of dark golden liquid swirled crazily, and a pink mist visible to the naked eye, mixed with the earth-shaking dragon roar, turned into a violent tide of dragon energy, directly engulfing the two people standing by the pool.
"Damn it! What are you stepping on, woman!"
Su Ming's expression suddenly changed and he couldn't help but curse secretly.
As soon as the pink mist entered his body, he noticed something was wrong.
Dragon nature is hidden!
What remains in this ancient dragon's blood is not only the power of Qi and blood, but also the most primitive and violent desire for reproduction of the ancient true dragon.
This tide is simply the most powerful aphrodisiac in the world!
Su Ming snorted coldly and immediately activated the Yin-Yang Divine Art. The Mysterious Gold Body was activated with a bang, forcibly suppressing the hot feeling in the meridians.
Relying on the tenacity of his two lives, he could still maintain his clarity.
But Nie Qingqiu behind him was not so capable.
"Son...I'm so hot..."
A moan that was so sweet that it made your bones brittle sounded in the pink mist.
Su Ming turned his head, and the sight in front of him made his breathing stagnate slightly.
The daughter of the city lord, who was originally as cold as icebergs and snow lotuses, now has her cheeks as red as blood, and her eyes are gleaming like autumn water. There is no trace of sanity at all.
She was breathing heavily, and her plump breasts were rising and falling violently, as if there was an unquenchable fire burning crazily in her body.
Under the erosion of dragon energy, the deepest desire in Nie Qingqiu's heart was infinitely magnified.
She looked at the tall and stern Su Ming in front of her. Her eyes no longer had the usual reserve and arrogance, but were replaced by the most primitive desire.
"Help me..."
Nie Qingqiu's charming eyes were as silk as silk, and he twisted his hot and enchanting water snake waist, walking towards Su Ming with some staggering steps.
As she walked, her jade hands took the initiative to climb up the lace around her waist.
Give it a gentle tug.
The precious purple close-fitting skirt slid down her fair shoulders, like a coquettish violet blooming in the mist, stacked on her ankles.
